instruction: Use the OPTIMADE API to query all structures with formula_prototype = "ABC3" (perovskite-type). Query at least two different database providers. For each provider that returns results, record the provider base URL and the count of matching structures. Then identify the provider with the highest count. Save the results to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\optimade\opt_task_19.txt' with: (1) one line per provider in the format 'url count'; (2) a final line in the format 'max_provider: url'.
_comments: OPTIMADE API task, no file input required
